scope: ToolScout first-party editorial dataset of public software product changes selected for buyer relevance. It is not a measure of global market share.
sourceMethod: Primary vendor documentation, changelogs, release notes and official product announcements. ToolScout classifies buyer impact independently of affiliate status.
editorialPolicy: Updates are selected for buyer relevance. Affiliate status, commission and partner relationships do not influence inclusion or placement.

themes.title: AI agents are becoming reusable team workflows
themes.summary: Recent product releases point toward reusable skills, shared AI behaviour and repeatable agent workflows instead of isolated prompting.

themes.title: Analysis and execution are moving closer together
themes.summary: More software updates are designed to reduce the handoff between understanding what happened and taking the next operational action.

updates.label: AI and automation update
updates.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
updates.summary: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.
updates.buyerImpact: ChatGPT buyers should verify how the new AI or automation capability changes workflow scope, governance and implementation effort.

updates.label: Security update
updates.title: Confidential comments on repository security advisories
updates.summary: You can now post confidential comments on repository security advisories.
updates.buyerImpact: GitHub buyers should verify whether the new controls change authentication, administration or security requirements for their team.

updates.label: Security update
updates.title: Repository security advisory comments API in public preview
updates.summary: You can now read, add, and edit comments on repository security advisories using the REST API, including advisories created from private vulnerability reports.
updates.buyerImpact: GitHub buyers should verify whether the new controls change authentication, administration or security requirements for their team.

updates.label: Security update
updates.title: New fields for SecurityAdvisory GraphQL API
updates.summary: You can now read more of the GitHub Advisory Database directly from the GraphQL API without falling back to the REST API.
updates.buyerImpact: GitHub buyers should verify whether the new controls change authentication, administration or security requirements for their team.

updates.label: Product retirement
updates.title: Selected models in GitHub Copilot deprecated
updates.summary: As of today, October 2, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across all GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions).
updates.buyerImpact: GitHub buyers should review migration, continuity and replacement requirements before relying on the affected workflow.

updates.label: Integration update
updates.title: Copilot code review: API support and new default effort level
updates.summary: You can now request a GitHub Copilot code review through the REST and GraphQL APIs and set the review effort level for each request.
updates.buyerImpact: GitHub buyers should reassess integration depth and automation architecture if connected workflows are central to the purchase decision.

updates.label: Security update
updates.title: Rate limits for private vulnerability reports
updates.summary: Open source maintainers are receiving more low-quality and automated vulnerability reports, which can bury the reports that matter.
updates.buyerImpact: GitHub buyers should verify whether the new controls change authentication, administration or security requirements for their team.

updates.label: Pricing and packaging update
updates.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
updates.summary: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.
updates.buyerImpact: ChatGPT buyers should re-check total cost and plan eligibility because packaging changes can alter the economics of an existing shortlist.

updates.label: Official product update
updates.title: GitHub Copilot adds local sandboxing and agent observability
updates.summary: GitHub Copilot adds local sandboxing, OpenTelemetry agent monitoring and expanded model choice for software teams.
updates.buyerImpact: GitHub buyers should verify how the new AI or automation capability changes workflow scope, governance and implementation effort.

updates.label: Official product update
updates.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 sharpens editing and speeds up generation
updates.summary: ChatGPT Images 2.5 improves detail, editing precision and generation speed while adding templates, sketch-based creation and prompt sharing.
updates.buyerImpact: ChatGPT buyers should compare the new capability against the requirements that originally put the product on their shortlist.

updates.label: Security update
updates.title: GitHub adds fresh authentication for high-impact enterprise actions
updates.summary: GitHub Enterprise Cloud can now require fresh re-authentication or MFA before managed users perform sensitive actions such as creating tokens or editing webhooks.
updates.buyerImpact: GitHub buyers should verify whether the new controls change authentication, administration or security requirements for their team.

updates.label: Security update
updates.title: GitHub sets new SSH security requirements for keys and clients
updates.summary: GitHub is phasing out older SSH cryptography, raising the minimum size for newly uploaded RSA keys and adding a post-quantum key exchange option.
updates.buyerImpact: GitHub buyers should verify whether the new controls change authentication, administration or security requirements for their team.
